start_month.label: Analysis period
start_month.help: The dates and hours whose sun or sky is protected.

start_day.label: Analysis period
start_day.help: The dates and hours whose sun or sky is protected.

start_hour.label: Analysis period
start_hour.help: The dates and hours whose sun or sky is protected.

end_month.label: Analysis period
end_month.help: The dates and hours whose sun or sky is protected.

end_day.label: Analysis period
end_day.help: The dates and hours whose sun or sky is protected.

end_hour.label: Analysis period
end_hour.help: The dates and hours whose sun or sky is protected.

north_deg.label: North direction
north_deg.help: Angle of north, clockwise from the model's +Y axis. 0 means +Y points north.

time_basis.label: Time
time_basis.help: How the hours of the analysis period are read. Standard time: the weather file's local time, without daylight saving. Daylight saving time: one hour ahead of standard time on every day of the period, so a period that runs past the change of the clocks is one hour off on the days outside it. Solar time: 12:00 is solar noon, when the sun is highest, as solar-fence rules and the Japanese shadow regulation count hours.

sun_steps_per_hour.label: Sun positions per hour
sun_steps_per_hour.help: How often the sun is sampled. 12 means every 5 minutes. More is more precise and slower.

min_altitude.label: Lowest sun protected
min_altitude.help: Sun positions lower than this above the horizon are not protected.

balance_temperature.label: Balance temperature
balance_temperature.help: The two ends of the dead band. Sun counts in hours colder than the lower end; with harm counted, hours warmer than the upper end count against it. The middle is the balance temperature: about 12 °C for offices, 18 °C for homes.

balance_offset.label: Balance temperature
balance_offset.help: The two ends of the dead band. Sun counts in hours colder than the lower end; with harm counted, hours warmer than the upper end count against it. The middle is the balance temperature: about 12 °C for offices, 18 °C for homes.

include_harm.label: Subtract summer overheating (experimental)
include_harm.help: Also counts sun in hot hours against the volume. Results then depend on how much summer the period includes.

tilted_plane_angle_deg.label: Plane angle
tilted_plane_angle_deg.help: Angle of the limiting plane above the horizontal: one value, or one per compass direction.

dew_point_celsius.label: Night dew point
dew_point_celsius.help: A typical night-time dew point; it sets how cold the clear sky is.

min_sky_elevation_deg.label: Protect sky above
min_sky_elevation_deg.help: Sky lower than this angle is not protected. 0 protects the whole sky.

bliss_k.label: Bliss constant
bliss_k.help: A physical constant of the sky model. Leave at 1.8 unless you know why.

voxel_size.label: Voxel size
voxel_size.help: Edge of the cubes the volume is divided into. Smaller is finer and slower: halving it makes 8 times as many voxels.

edge_taper.label: Edge strip with less weight
edge_taper.help: Sample points closer than this to the edge of a test surface count less (from 0 at the edge to full at this distance), so a cooling street or courtyard does not clear the mass right beside it. 0 = off.

rays_per_patch.label: Rays per sky patch
rays_per_patch.help: Rays traced from each test point toward each of the 145 sky patches. With 1, one ray goes to the centre of the patch; the centres are 12° apart, so far from the test surfaces whole layers of voxels fall between the rays and the scores show bands. 4 spreads the rays over each patch and closes the gaps; 9 and 16 are finer and slower.

ray_batch_size.label: Rays per batch
ray_batch_size.help: 0 sizes batches from free GPU memory. Lower it if the computer runs out of memory.

diagnostics.label: Detailed statistics
diagnostics.help: Adds median, spread and percentiles to the run report. They change only the run report, not the carving.

context_blocks_rays.label: Account for context blocking
context_blocks_rays.help: On: sun and sky that the existing surroundings or the terrain already block count for no voxel, so the carving keeps more where they shade. Off: they still take their voxels, but block nothing, to compare with the carving without them.

threshold.label: Carving rule
threshold.help: Manual, the rule to start with: you set the carve amount, a share of the total score, with the slider or by dragging the line on the histogram. Automatic: the cut is found from the spread of the scores; dragging the line switches to Manual.

help_for_modes.time-based: How much shade one voxel may cast on the protected surfaces over the period. 0 removes any voxel that casts any shade; 5 allows 5 m² for one hour.

carve_fraction.label: Carve amount
carve_fraction.help: Share of the total obstruction to remove, not of the volume. Higher gives a slimmer, lower building.

score_smoothing.label: Score smoothing
score_smoothing.help: Blurs the scores before cutting so the surface is cleaner. Empty means automatic (1.1 × voxel size).

carve_above.label: Remove everything above a cut
carve_above.help: Once a column is cut, everything above it goes too, so nothing floats.

carve_above_min_consecutive.label: Cut voxels needed to remove above
carve_above_min_consecutive.help: How many cut voxels in a row start the removal above. 2 or 3 ignores stray single voxels.

max_slope_deg.label: Steepest step between columns
max_slope_deg.help: Limits how steeply heights may jump between neighbours, turning spikes into ramps. 90 turns it off.

apply_smoothing.label: Smooth the envelope surface
apply_smoothing.help: Off: a stepped voxel surface. On: a smoothed surface.

smooth_iters.label: Smoothing passes
smooth_iters.help: How many polishing passes the smoothed surface gets, 0 to 6.

min_voxels.label: Drop pieces smaller than
min_voxels.help: Loose pieces of the kept volume smaller than this are removed before meshing. The engine counts it in voxels: the volume shown is that count at the voxel size in Settings, and follows it when the voxel size changes.

min_face_count.label: Drop mesh fragments under
min_face_count.help: Mesh pieces with fewer faces than this are removed.

floor_height.label: Upper floor height
floor_height.help: Height of every floor above the ground floor.

min_plate_dimension.label: Grid module
min_plate_dimension.help: The square module the storeys are built from, and the narrowest piece of floor allowed.

plate_tolerance.label: Permitted volume exceedance
plate_tolerance.help: Share of a module on a storey that may lie outside the carved envelope. The massing never leaves the maximum volume.

plate_stacking.label: Floors rest on floors below
plate_stacking.help: Supported: a module is built only on a module below. Free: each storey is decided on its own.

final_mesh_format.label: Mesh file format
final_mesh_format.help: The file type of the carved envelope and the building massing.
